description_sq:
SHITET APARTAMENT 3+1+2 NE REZIDENCEN PARK GATE, RRUGA E ELBASANIT.
Park Gate eshte nje objekt me stil shume te vecante arkitekturor dhe strukturor, prane hyrjes se Parkut te Tiranes ne Rrugen e Elbasanit. Pozicioni mjaft strategjik, perballe Fakultetit te Histori Filologjise dhe Fakultetit Ekonomik, ne Rrugen e Elbasanit dhe fare prane Parkut te Liqenit Artificial, e bejne kete objekt dhe me te lakmuar nga klientet, si per banim ashtu dhe per biznes.
“Park Gate” përfshin 2 kate shërbime, 5 dhe 11 kate banim, si edhe 2 kate parkim nëntokësor.
Ky apartament organizohet ne dhome ndenje me dalje ne ballkon, kuzhine te vecuar, 3 dhoma gjumi dhe 2 tualete. Banesa vendoset ne nje pozicion mjaft strategjik pasi ofron pamje nga Parku i Liqenit Artificial. Shitet totalisht i mobiluar me nje arredim modern si ne foto.
Mundesi blerje per poste parkimi me cmim ekstra
Per me teper informacion dhe nje vizite ne prone, na kontaktoni!
description_en: APARTMENT 3+1+2 FOR SALE IN PARK GATE RESIDENCE, ELBASANI STREET. Park Gate is an object with a very special architectural and structural style, near the entrance to Tirana Park on Elbasan Street. The very strategic position, in front of the Faculty of History, Philology and the Faculty of Economics, on Elbasan Street and very close to the Artificial Lake Park, makes this object even more coveted by customers, both for residence and for business. "Park Gate" includes 2 service floors, 5 and 11 residential floors, as well as 2 underground parking floors. This apartment is organized in a living room with access to the balcony, a separate kitchen, 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms. The apartment is placed in a very strategic position as it offers a view of the Artificial Lake Park. It is sold fully furnished with modern furnishings as in the photo. The possibility of purchasing a parking post at an extra price. For more information and a visit to the property, contact us!
